name: SplitSigmas / SplitSigmasDenoise
plain: Cuts a schedule at a step or a denoise fraction into a high part and a low part that share one boundary sigma, for two-stage or two-model sampling.
math:
SplitSigmas: high=σ[:step+1], low=σ[step:].
SplitSigmasDenoise: k=round((len−1)·denoise); high=σ[:−k], low=σ[−(k+1):].

providers.author: matlowai
providers.note: Head part only: σ[:probe_steps+1] of a named core scheduler (default 6 of 25), for a cheap early x0 probe.

label: from code
surprise: SplitSigmasDenoise at denoise=0 slices σ[:−0], which is empty, instead of returning the whole schedule as high (nodes_custom_sampler.py:247-249).
